events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for his work with Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, his genius has kept us laughing for decades.

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury, would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury today. A voice that shook stadiums and a legend who would have been 80. Play Queen loud.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul' in 1965
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life'.

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: 59 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly changed the game and sounds as fresh as ever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Tribute to John Lennon, would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a visionary artist who would have been 86. His message of peace and love continues to resonate.

events.title: Tribute to David Bowie, would have been 80
events.blurb: We remember the extraordinary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Forever a legend. Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. His music and artistry are truly timeless.

events.title: Tribute to Elvis Presley, would have been 92
events.blurb: Celebrating the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy 92nd heavenly birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley! The King's legacy still shines brightly.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The riffs, the solos, the legend. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the legendary British singer with a distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking and still sounding incredible. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs from Madness turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing those good times and classic tunes. What's your favourite Madness singalong?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still got that soulful sound. What's your favourite Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A true living legend and an inspiration to millions. Here's to more sparkle!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, a true pop royalty.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' and celebrate.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held, honouring pioneers of the genre.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Remembering the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony from 1989. Who would be your first pick for induction?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, known for his distinct vocals and songwriting contributions, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still charming us with his unique style and music. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic and final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rocks
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye to live performances!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Award-winning singer-songwriter and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the moves.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Only Fools & Horses Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97) tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Legends
angles.copy: 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose music lives on forever.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the legendary Rick Astley! Still got the moves and the voice. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Tribute to Bob Marley, would have been 82
events.blurb: Today marks the birthday of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have been 82 years old.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of 'One Love' still resonates globally.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: American singer-songwriter Carole King, a prolific hitmaker and 'Tapestry' artist, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting legend who has given us so many timeless classics.
